why: phase-417 W5.c — a read of the arena's own timer accounting, exposed so the C accessors forward rather than recompute. rclrs puts the equivalents on `Timer`; RFC-0002's arena owns timer state here, so there is no owning `Timer` object to hang them on and they sit on the executor. Returns `Option` deliberately: "not a timer handle" is a different answer from `0`/`false`, which is issue 1008's shape.
